name: Lead Intake · 4 Errors
description: Marks failed leads and alerts Slack.

parameters.content:
## Errors
Runs when any Lead Intake workflow fails (after the per-node retries). Marks the lead as `error` in the log and posts to Slack. The next time the same lead arrives it is retried, skipping steps that already succeeded.

parameters.query:
UPDATE intake.leads SET status = 'error', error = $2, updated_at = now()
WHERE execution_id = $1 AND status = 'processing' RETURNING id
